messages:
Raj: Quick update — GPU reservations R-8721 / R-8722 confirmed for west-us2. Racks r-45..r-48 expected Weds morning. Can we confirm owners for rack power, burn-in, canary nodes, and who wires VLAN/firewall? cc @Liz @Asha

Liz: I can own burn-in + canary smoke (runtime). Need VLAN details and IP plan from infra before I stage images. Will run 12h burn-in per node.

Connor: Filed VLAN access request TKT-4587 (infra). ETA ~24h. Also vendor flagged a firmware maintenance window: Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC — might affect early tests.

Asha: ML team will run perf baselines: model=v2-7b, seq=2048, mixed-precision. We need a path for sample weights + eval prompts. Who drops the artifacts into S3?

Raj: Procurement says shipment manifests included; @ops-bot will post the doc. Note: reservations are provisioned but limited — capacity flagged to 80% until canaries are green.

ops-bot: Shipment manifest uploaded: https://internal.storage/shipments/R-8721-manifest.csv. Firmware window confirmed Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Attached r45_manifest.csv in the ticket.

Connor: Power estimate per rack ~22kW. We'll need a scheduled breaker test Monday EOD to confirm load balancing across PDUs.

Liz: Canary plan: 2 nodes/rack, run 12h burn-in, run perf harness against v2-7b-lite (short weights) then heavy. If kernel OOMs or repeated ECC errors — automatic fallback to smaller batch kernel. I'll add the failure criteria.

Miguel: SRE will stand up alerting for the onboarding window. Proposed alert: GPU_mem_error >= 5/min -> pager. I'll create PagerDuty runbook and a short diagnosis checklist.

Raj: Draft ownership matrix: infra: Connor (network/power), procurement/firmware: Sofia, runtime/canaries: Liz, perf/evals: Asha, SRE/alerts: Miguel. Objections?

Sofia: Procurement confirms vendor will hold 4 spare PSU kits (one per rack) for 48h post-delivery; if needed they'll ship next-day (+2 days typical).

Asha: S3 path request: please populate s3://redwood-capacity/canary/v2-7b with tokenizer + small weights for initial smoke. Who will upload?

Liz: I'll stage a thin artifact today (tokenizer + 100M slice) into that path. Full weights after VLAN + firewall are green.

Raj: ACTIONS (owner / due):
  1) Connor: publish breaker test schedule & VLAN plan by EOD (T-2d).
  2) Liz: stage artifacts and upload burn-in plan + failure criteria (today).
  3) Miguel: create PD runbook & link (before canary).
  4) Sofia: confirm spare kit shipping timeline in procurement ticket.
  5) Raj: mark reservations R-8721/8722 as 'canary-blocked' until burn-in is green.

Connor: On it. Will update TKT-4587 and @Raj once breaker slot booked.

Miguel: I'll post the runbook link and a short checklist in this thread when ready.

Sofia: Noted, updating procurement ticket with the spare-kit SLA.

Liz: staging artifacts now. Will post S3 link and a short runbook for the burn-in scripts.

Raj: Thanks everyone. If nothing major surfaces, plan remains: delivery Weds morning, breaker test Mon EOD, canaries start Tues evening (post-firmware window), full ramp after green. :thumbsup:

(Reaction summary: many :thumbsup: and a few :eyes:)
